input: RGB photo, 224x224, pixel values 0-255 (float32), NHWC; scaling to the network's range is inside the model
preprocessing: resize the short side to 256 px, then crop the centre 224x224
output: softmax probabilities, one per class in labels.txt order
trained_on: data/machines13_team (Roboflow sets + the team's web photos) plus 390 real-world YouTube frames, 30 per machine, picked by eye (youtube_frames.json); runs/machines13_yt/finetune/yt_s42

youtube_test_26.note: 2 frames per machine from videos not used for training (youtube_frames.json 'test')
